booking.heading: Make a booking request.
booking.body: Share your details and preferred date. Review your request, then open your email app to send it to me.
booking.preferenceNotice: Your preferred date is a request, not a reservation or booking confirmation.
booking.detailsHeading: Tell me what you have in mind.

aside.heading: A considered request.
aside.body: Keep the details clear. Your email and preferred date help me understand what you have in mind.

preferredDate.label: Preferred date (required)
preferredDate.helper: This is your preference, not a confirmed date.

note.label: A short note (optional)
note.placeholder: What would you like to arrange?
note.helper: Keep this brief. Do not include passwords, payment details or identity documents.

adult.label: I confirm that I am 18 or older.

policy.label: I understand that this is a request and have read the booking information.

review.heading: Check the details.
review.body: Make sure your email and preferred date are correct before you prepare your request.
review.notice: Nothing has been sent. Your next step creates a message you can send by email.

ready.heading: Your request is ready.
ready.body: Open your email app and send the prepared message. It has not been sent by this website, and your booking is not confirmed.
ready.copyFallback: Select and copy the request text below, then paste it into your email.
ready.noEmail: Email is unavailable here. You can still copy your request.
ready.longEmail: This message is too long to open reliably in an email app. Copy it and send it to the address below.
ready.leavingNotice: Leaving or refreshing this page clears your draft.

faq.question: Does this confirm my booking?
faq.answer: No. This website prepares your request. Send it by email and wait for my confirmation before making plans.

faq.question: Which currency is used?
faq.answer: All booking prices are in USD. If a price is not listed, it will be agreed by email.

faq.question: Can I choose an available date?
faq.answer: You can request a preferred date. Availability is agreed in the reply; this site does not show a live calendar.

errors.alias: Enter a name or alias of up to 60 characters.

errors.preferredDate: Choose a valid date that is today or later.
errors.note: Keep your note to 1,000 characters and use plain text.
errors.adult: Confirm that you are 18 or older to continue.
errors.policy: Read and acknowledge the booking information to continue.

policies.heading: Before you request.
policies.intro: A clear request is the first step. Here is how it works.

sections.heading: Prepare, then send
sections.body: Complete the request on this website and review your details. The final screen prepares a message. Open your email app to send it, or copy the text into your own email. This website does not send the request for you.

sections.heading: Date and confirmation
sections.body: The date you choose is a preference. It is not reserved. A request, gift or subscription does not confirm a booking. Wait for my personal confirmation before making plans.

sections.heading: Pricing in USD
sections.body: All listed booking amounts are in USD. If a rate is not listed, the price will be agreed by email. This website does not collect booking payments.

sections.heading: Keep the request simple
sections.body: Use a name or alias, a working reply email and your preferred date. Do not include payment credentials or identity documents in the note.

sections.heading: Adults only
sections.body: You must be 18 or older to enter this website or prepare a request.

privacy.heading: Your details.
privacy.intro: This is a static website. Here is what happens when you enter and prepare a request.

sections.heading: Your entry choice
sections.body: The site remembers your adult-entry choice for the current browser session. It does not collect a date of birth or identity document.

sections.heading: Your request draft
sections.body: Booking details stay in the page’s memory while you prepare and review them. Leaving or refreshing the page clears the draft. The website does not submit your booking details to a server.

sections.heading: Sending by email
sections.body: If you choose Open email to send, your email app receives the prepared message. You decide whether to send it. Email handling and retention then follow your email provider and the recipient’s correspondence process; this website cannot observe delivery.

sections.heading: Copying your request
sections.body: Copy places the request on your clipboard when your browser allows it. Copying does not send the request.

sections.heading: Other platforms
sections.body: Official links take you to other services. Their privacy practices apply on those pages. This site does not embed their feeds or payment forms.

sections.heading: Site files
sections.body: Your browser requests ordinary website files from the hosting provider. Hosting may process routine connection information. No analytics or advertising tracker is added by this website.

exit.heading: You have left the site.
exit.body: You can close this tab. No booking request has been sent by this website.
